settings.question: When will my jewellery order be delivered?
settings.answer: Ready-to-ship designs are typically dispatched within 2–4 business days. Made-to-order, custom engraved or resized pieces require 7–15 business days for master craftsmanship, followed by 2–5 business days of insured courier transit.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: As soon as your jewellery is handed over to our insured courier partner, you will receive a tracking link via SMS and email with live transit updates and estimated delivery time.

settings.question: Do you offer custom bridal and bespoke design consultations?
settings.answer: Yes! Our master jewellery designers specialize in bespoke creations. Select 'Custom bridal & jewellery design' in the contact form above or reach out via WhatsApp to begin your personalized consultation.

settings.question: What is your return and exchange window?
settings.answer: Eligible pieces can be returned or exchanged within 15 calendar days of verified delivery, subject to intact security tags, original luxury packaging, certificates and invoice.
